answer: Locks are logged in copper, expire in wander, and lantern lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 48 aliases thus needs 41 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2648 identities would post 3364 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
